name: danesh-desktop
description: A local-first, Persian-first desktop learning environment for source-grounded study.
author: Danesh contributors

scripts.package: electron-vite build && node ../../tools/assert-no-test-hooks.ts --out out && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never && node ../../tools/smoke/build-manifest.ts --dist dist
scripts.package:test: electron-vite build --mode test && node ../../tools/assert-no-test-hooks.ts --out out --expect-present && electron-builder --config electron-builder.test.yml --publish never --dir && node ../../tools/smoke/build-manifest.ts --dist dist-test
